Database

Postgres Pro

Enterprise-Grade PostgreSQL

Advanced PostgreSQL fork providing enhanced performance, scalability, reliability, and security for mission-critical enterprise workloads — developed by one of the world's top PostgreSQL contributors.

Overview

Postgres Pro is developed by Postgres Professional, one of the world's leading PostgreSQL vendors and a top-3 contributor to the open-source PostgreSQL project. Postgres Pro DBMS builds on PostgreSQL with proprietary enhancements that boost performance, strengthen security, and simplify enterprise operations.

Available in Standard and Enterprise editions, Postgres Pro delivers features like 64-bit transaction IDs, advanced query optimization, Oracle compatibility layers, and enterprise-grade security — all backed by 24/7/365 expert support, consulting, and migration assistance.

Editions

Postgres Pro Standard

Reliable PostgreSQL with enterprise enhancements for mid-size deployments.

Postgres Pro Enterprise

Advanced clustering, security, and scalability for large organizations.

Enterprise Manager (PPEM)

Centralized monitoring and management dashboard for fleet operations.

Key Features

Enterprise capabilities that extend PostgreSQL for demanding production environments.

64-bit Transaction IDs

Long-term stability for massive workloads without transaction ID wraparound concerns.

Advanced Query Optimization

AI-driven adaptive query tuning that automatically optimizes execution plans over time.

Oracle Compatibility

PL/SQL packages, collections, and Ora2pg Pro utility for seamless Oracle-to-Postgres migration.

Enterprise Security

pg_proaudit extension, advanced authentication policies, and fine-grained access control.

Compressed File System

CFS technology for storage efficiency when handling large data volumes.

Incremental Backup

Efficient recovery with minimal downtime through intelligent incremental backup strategies.

Table Partitioning

Optimized partitioning for large datasets, delivering better performance at scale.

Resource Management

Fine-grained control over resource-intensive operations to prevent workload contention.

Business Benefits

Reduced Licensing Costs

Open-source foundation with enterprise features eliminates expensive proprietary database licensing.

Simplified Migration

Purpose-built tools make Oracle and other proprietary database migrations predictable and low-risk.

Enterprise Reliability

24/7 expert support from the team that contributes directly to PostgreSQL core development.

Future-Proof Investment

Built on the world's most advanced open-source database with guaranteed long-term roadmap.
